limiting_factors: h180 dominates the loss (46% of champion Discovery loss; q90 breach 32.4%, mean bias -0.23): the drift is family-heterogeneous (p5/A100->H100 premium families ROSE 2023-24 while p4d fell ~-0.35 log), and the champion's single pooled 730-day family change-quantile set cannot represent both directions - its worst series are exactly the rising p5 AZs (coverage 0.52-0.67, share_of_total_loss up to 14%).

Per-series information is unused: the champion pools change quantiles per instance family only; a 50/50 per-series x family blend measured +0.030/+0.050/+0.049 h180 skill on pseudo-origins in ALL THREE windows tested (2024-09, 2024-06, 2024-03 cuts), the single biggest unclaimed lever.

h30 is the weakest horizon (skill 0.197, 16% of loss): the 730-day pooled h30 change quantiles over-disperse relative to 30-day administered moves; band narrowing x0.8 around q50 measured +0.014/+0.015 skill (and +0.41 vs -1.91 in the falling-price window).

h90 q10 breach 13-18% on pseudo-origins (prices falling below q10 in the 2024 drawdown): asymmetric q10 lifts and recent-window blends were sign-mixed across windows - no reliable lever found yet; the h90 fix likely has to come from the per-series blend (psmix30: +0.008/-0.002/+0.007), not the band.

Exogenous/news drift gates are unusable: point-in-time news is direction-mixed at every origin tested (g001's web-news drift gate never fired; CostPulse 2024-08-02 shows 65,388 cuts AND 259,823 increases the same day) - regime information must be extracted from the pack itself.

Gate-3 coverage risk on the leading stack: the ps_mix + nar08 stack lowers pseudo-window coverage by ~0.03 (0.71 vs 0.73 pooled); the champion's Discovery->Holdout coverage gap was +0.09 (0.664 -> 0.7545), so projected Holdout coverage ~0.72-0.76 straddles the gate-3 floor (>= 0.7495 unless in [0.74, 0.86]) - measure dry-run coverage and keep a small h180 q90 uplift in reserve (q90up10 was +0.006 h180 skill in the 2024-09 window).
data_quality_issues: 116 of 133 target series have NO history at Discovery origins (p4de/p5e/p5en/p6-b200/p6-b300 and most AZs start after 2024-09): at Holdout origins 2025-03+ these families appear with short histories, so per-series levers must guard min-pairs (>=30 change pairs) with pooled/last-value fallbacks or they will produce noise or crashes (cf. PACK_PLUS_EXA iter-5 ZeroDivisionError on short card series).
p4d.24xlarge.use2-az1 starts 2024-01-31 (215 days) - a short series inside Discovery; its per-series quantiles are unstable and it was among the worst series (coverage 0.50).

Forward-filled days (is_filled) reach 47.8% of the last 90 on p4d use1-az1 and 41% on euc1-az3: change quantiles computed over filled stretches understate true volatility and bias the band narrow exactly where breaches occur.

aws_spot.p4d.24xlarge.az_median is a DERIVED family median series: including it in the family cross-sectional median and in pooled family change quantiles double-counts the median AZ and dampens the reversion signal; it should be excluded from csmed and from pooled quantile estimation.

daily_statistics, aggregator_medians and index_prints are EMPTY (0 rows) at all Discovery origins in this stage - no exogenous pack tables exist; hardware_fundamentals/capability_ladder map to launch prices, not to the spot collectors (unusable for level anchoring, confirmed in prior stages).
data_needed: The 53 non-target AWS spot series (other AZs / p6) that exist in the source tick data but are absent from this stage's series_history: they would enlarge family cross-sections (better csmed, more pooled change pairs) and give early history for the p6 families that appear at Holdout; daily close, point-in-time truncated at origin.
Raw aws_spot_ticks (intraday) or n_obs-weighted daily statistics, to de-bias change quantiles computed over forward-filled days (48% filled share on one p4d AZ).

A structured, dated AWS EC2 price-change feed (CostPulse-style per-instance cut/increase counts, e.g. costpulse.io/aws-price-changes/ 2024-08-02: 65,388 cuts vs 259,823 increases) retrievable point-in-time via external_signals.search: free-text news is direction-mixed (falsified twice), but a quantitative net-cut/net-increase series would give a real, falsifiable drift gate for the 30-180d center.

A per-series residual/breach diagnostic in the Discovery dry-run output (per-series q10/q90 breach rates, not just per-slice) would let us attribute the h180 q90 breach to families without burning an analyze_discovery call.
hypotheses: [ensemble/cross_series, incremental, builds_on iter-1] Per-series x family 730d change-quantile blend: q = w*q_series + (1-w)*q_family + cs_shift with w=0.5 at h180, 0.3 at h90, 0 at h30 (per-series quantiles need >=30 own change pairs, else fall back to family). Mechanism: each AZ's administered price path has series-specific jump sizes the family pool smooths; averaging two unbiased quantile estimates halves estimation noise without adding bias. Measured on monthly pseudo-origins in three windows: h180 +0.030/+0.050/+0.049 skill, pooled stack +0.022/+0.029/+0.049 vs the champion replica, positive in the falling-price 2023 window too. Falsified if the Discovery dry-run pooled <= champion 0.2675 or if h90/h180 regress out of sample.

[interval_calibration, incremental] h30-only band narrowing x0.8 around q50 (q10/q90 pulled 20% toward q50, q50 unchanged). Mechanism: 30-day administered moves are smaller than the 730-day pooled h30 change distribution (over-dispersion); measured +0.014/+0.015 skill on pseudo-origins and +0.41 vs -1.91 in the falling 2023 window - the largest h30 lever found, and h30 is the weakest horizon (0.197). Falsified if h30 dry-run skill <= 0.197.

[regime_change, bold] Family-conditional h180 upper tail: the 32% h180 q90 breach concentrates in rising families (p5 coverage 0.52-0.67) while falling families breach q10; widen the h180 q90 by a family-recent-trend-scaled amount (or use family-specific recent-window quantiles only for the upper tail). Must be pseudo-origin tested first - unconditional q90 uplifts were sign-mixed (+0.006/-0.009) and recent-window blends were negative at h30/h90.

[robustness, incremental] Holdout-readiness guards for the 116 late-starting series: min-pairs fallbacks, csmed min-group >= 3, exclude az_median from family stats, last-value fallback for empty histories - without these the promoted levers will crash or emit noise cells at 2025 origins (Gate-4 floor -0.020 per horizon).

[exogenous_signals, deprioritized] News drift gate via external_signals.search: falsified twice (g001 gate never fired, direction-mixed evidence at 2023-12 and 2024-09 origins); do not spend a dry run unless a quantitative price-change feed (see data_needed) becomes available inside predict_origin.
